terms_note: This is the catch-all for any server that speaks the OpenAI images protocol (POST <base_url>/images/generations). Rights, prices and limits are the server operator's. Not live-verified: the adapter was built from the documented request and response shape, not from a recorded call. The model and base_url come from the project config and no model table exists here, so prices are unknown. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing.
